name: Two Female Profiles and Swallows, c. 1898–1900
note: Neck pendant or brooch in gold, plique-à-jour enamel and a baroque pearl, with a sculpted pair of female profiles and enamel swallows. The printed caption on the book page lists it as cat. 116 in a Lalique catalogue; the photo on the page is plate 113.
credit: Lalique Museum, Hakone (Japan), per the printed caption (cat. 116)
